Notes_and_Tips: Fixed routine works in your favour—keep meal timings consistent.
Stress triggers sweet cravings; start meals with protein and slow down.
Avoid keeping desserts at home on weekdays.
Simple, repeatable meals reduce decision fatigue.
Light movement or short walks can support mental wellbeing.
Focus on calm, steady progress rather than quick results.
